test_title: PYST 7: SSC CPO - Reasoning(Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Given below are two statements and two conclusions. Take the statements to be true even if they are at variance with commonly known facts, and decide whether the conclusion(s) follow(s) the given statements.

**Statements :**

All irons are coppers.

All coppers are aluminiums.

**Conclusions :**

I. Some aluminum are irons

II. Some aluminum are coppers

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
Given Statements :

All irons are coppers.

All coppers are aluminum.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11aa02f4a46d4812a838f501dfac61e71bb05eb1ab6b1e6ade2bb27d29d54c14.png] 

Conclusions :

I. Some aluminum are irons - **True **(Because, All iron are copper and all copper are Aluminum. So the part of aluminum which is copper is also iron)

II. Some aluminum are coppers - **True **(Because, All copper are aluminum, so some aluminum is copper also)

So, Both conclusion follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
